🤭How to make money online selling products on Etsy you didn't make yourself using the done for you designs & print on demand method!  👇🏼Read for a step by step!  🙌🏼 How Print On Demand Works:  1. Do Some Quick Product Research - Look for popular items people are buying, like wall art, t-shirts, sweatshirts, phone cases, candles, mugs, or tote bags.   - Use tools like erank, Google Trends or browse online shops to see what's trending. I also look for inspo on Pinterest all the time! I like to use Everbee to see how much money a product is making on Etsy.  2. Create Your Design  - Get done for you designs on ctrl-alt-design.com  - Or create your own. Make your design fun, eye-catching, or niche-specific. Keep it simple and high-quality!   3. Sign Up on Printify  - Create a free account & make sure you connect your account to a store. Examples being Etsy or Shopify. You are walked through how to do this when you sign up, don’t worry it’s easy and fast.  4. Choose a Product on Printify   - Browse the product catalog for posters, t-shirts, hoodies, candles, hats, mugs, phone cases & etc.   - Select the product you want to sell.   5. Upload Your Design   - Click on the product to customize it.   - Upload your design.   - Position and resize it to fit the product nicely.   6. Fill Out Listing Details  - Write a catchy product title and description with keywords.   - Set your price (consider costs and your profit margin).   7. Publish Your Product  - Remember to connect your online store (Shopify, Etsy, etc.) with Printful . This makes it so whenever you make a sale, Printify knows instantly so it can print the design on the product for you and send it to the customer for you!  - Publish your product so it’s live and ready for customers.   8. Market Your Product - Share your product on social media, use Pinterest, create ads, or tell friends. Make videos of your product or make Pinterest pins.  - Focus on your target audience to attract more buyers. Not a must but it can help!  #howtomakemoneyonline #sidehustle #onlinesidehustle #printondemand #digitalproducts

Starting December 16, Etsy can use seller photos and listings to train AI. This isn't just Etsy. Big platforms and marketplaces are racing to build their own unique graph, like a shopping graph or a taste graph, by learning from everything we upload. Your content is what they're building it with. So take a tip from them and build your own graph. I save every video I make before it goes anywhere, with its caption, cover, and topic, so I know what I've made and what worked. Do the same with your product photos, listings, and customers. Once your content is organized in one place you own, you can reuse it anywhere and no platform holds your business. What would be in your content graph if you started one today? Etsy acaba de cambiar las reglas de la IA 🚨 Las nuevas reglas de Etsy si vendes print on demand o diseños con IA, en menos de 2 minutos 👇 El correo nos llegó a todos los que tenemos tienda y lo firma uno de los vicepresidentes de Etsy. Son 3 cambios: 1️⃣ La foto: la mayoría de los listings ahora tienen que llevar una foto real del producto, sin editar. En print on demand puedes seguir usando mockups, pero con los derechos de su dueño. Si tu mockup enseña un color que no es, el cliente puede abrir un caso y el reembolso lo puedes pagar tú. Y vale también para los listings que ya tienes. 2️⃣ Bots: los listings creados en automático, sin una persona detrás, se borran y te pueden cerrar la tienda. Los patrones, recetas y guías hechos con IA también quedan fuera. 3️⃣ Etsy revisa tus fotos: detecta las hechas con IA y más adelante revisará las que ya tienes. Los compradores van a poder reportar tu listing si creen que las imágenes son engañosas. ¿Etsy prohíbe la IA? No: prohíbe esconderlo. La IA se sigue declarando en la descripción (al final del vídeo tienes un ejemplo para hacerle captura). 💬 ¿Te llegó el correo? ¿Usas IA en tus diseños? 🎥 Más tutoriales en mi canal de YouTube (enlace en mi perfil): https://www.youtube.com/@EduarLias 🔎 ZEUS, la herramienta que uso para saber qué vender: https://zeusseller.com/es/ #etsy #printondemand #diseñosconia #inteligenciaartificial #etsyseller

Let's rank 5 in order of waste of time to absolutely ESSENTIAL!  5️⃣ Obsessing over your logo and branding. Please, just choose one or two fonts, pick a colour palette, make your logo look half decent and MOVE ON. 4️⃣ Filling out your shop sections. Now, this one is actually worth your time. Fill out ALL of it. Your About section, shop policies, FAQs, announcement, everything! 3️⃣Validating demand for your products. Before you spend hours designing, making or creating a whole collection of products, get yourself a keyword research tool and see whether people are actually searching for what you're planning to sell. 2️⃣ SEO. Your titles, tags and descriptions. You need to understand what your potential customers are actually searching for and incorporate those keywords into your titles, tags and descriptions. 1️⃣Your listing images. Your thumbnail is the first thing people see when they're scrolling through Etsy. If it doesn't catch their attention, they're not clicking. And no clicks means no sales. You need a clear, eye-catching, scroll-stopping first image that makes someone want to find out more! Your time is precious. Spend it on the things that actually have the potential to make you sales! #etsydigitalsidehustle #etsydigitalproduct #etsysellerforbeginners #digitalproductsforbeginners
